M-Audio Announces Acquisition of Evolution Electronics
Deal makes M-Audio world’s largest supplier of USB MIDI keyboards and controllers

Arcadia, CA, August 1, 2003 — M-Audio, a leading manufacturer and distributor of hardware and software for computer-centric musicians, today announced the 100% acquisition of Evolution Electronics Ltd., a UK-based manufacturer of USB MIDI keyboards and controllers.

M-Audio, Inc. has acquired all Evolution products, software, and intellectual property rights, along with all other assets and liabilities of the company in exchange for an undisclosed sum.

Says Tim Ryan, CEO of M-Audio Inc., “We are very excited about bringing M-Audio and Evolution capabilities together. It is clear to us that this joining of forces will make a sum greater than the parts.” The transaction makes M-Audio the largest supplier of USB MIDI keyboards and controllers in the world and adds considerable strength to the existing product development and manufacturing capabilities.

“We’re honored to join the M-Audio family,” says Evolution founder Richard Watts, “and are looking forward to extending our reach and vision to a new level.” Watts, who built the company over the past 20 years, will continue to be involved within the enlarged group. Niels Larsen is now acting as general manager of Evolution.

Contact details:
M-Audio, Inc.
U.S. media contact: Kevin Walt at 800-969-6434 x229 or kevin@m-audio.com

Evolution Electronics Ltd.
Niels Larsen +44 (0) 1525 372621 or niels.larsen@evolution.co.uk

About M-Audio
M-Audio is a leading provider of creative tools for today’s electronic musicians and audio professionals. Founded in 1988, M-Audio now has independent offices in the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France and Japan. M-Audio’s ability to parlay advanced technology into affordable products has led the company to win some of the international audio community’s highest praise and awards. M-Audio’s mission of “Redefining the Studio” delivers new levels of control, virtualization and mobility that transform the way computer-centric musicians compose, perform and live their creative lives. In addition to manufacturing its own product lines like the popular Delta audio cards, Studiophile reference monitors and USB MIDI controllers, M-Audio also distributes best-of-class products such as Propellerhead’s Reason, Ableton’s Live, ArKaos VJ and Groove Tubes microphones. In 2002, the Company successfully launched a product line that brings professional-quality audio to the consumer electronics market.
